note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as published by PlayStation (via Exophase / PSNProfiles). Guides are written for this entry in our own words; each trophy names its sources. Where a method is not yet verified in the game, the guide says so plainly.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops automatically. There is nothing extra to do beyond the rest of the list, so treat it as the finish line, not a task of its own. PowerPyx puts the whole run at about 200 hours and difficulty 4/10: long, not hard.
steps: Earn all 54 other trophies.
The platinum pops on its own.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to the end. It is the first story mission, so this is unmissable — just follow the story. PowerPyx confirms it unlocks after the first main mission in Chapter 1.
steps: Start the story and finish Gone Fishing.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. The trophy pops when the chapter closes — PowerPyx notes chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene, so do not worry if it is a beat late.
steps: Complete all Chapter 1 missions.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Unmissable through normal story play; it pops as the chapter closes.
steps: Complete all Chapter 2 missions.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. Unmissable through normal story play.
steps: Complete all Chapter 3 missions.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. Unmissable through normal story play; PowerPyx places the chapter's final mission, Starting From Zero, here.
steps: Complete all Chapter 4 missions.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story. Keep a manual save from just before it — there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus (PowerPyx, OutputLag), so a spare save is your only way back if you want to replay the ending.
steps: Make a manual save before the final mission.
Complete the final mission.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. It pops as part of the story, and PowerPyx notes this is the mission after which you can switch between Jason and Lucia and play together.
steps: Complete the mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. Unmissable — it pops when the mission ends.
steps: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play in Chapter 4. Unmissable — it pops when the mission ends.
steps: Complete the mission Child's Play in Chapter 4.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners in Chapter 4. Unmissable — it pops when the mission ends.
steps: Complete the mission Headliners in Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. Unmissable — it pops when the mission ends.
steps: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. PowerPyx places this mission in Chapter 5, after the Chapter 4 missions. Unmissable — it pops when the mission ends.
steps: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Fill the in-game 100% Completion checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion), which only appears after the story. PowerPyx reports it is forgiving — closer to 60% true completion — needing, among other things, 300 stunts, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied and 70 of 80 Challenges. Work done during the story already counts, and nothing on the checklist is missable.
steps: Finish the story to reveal the checklist.
Work through the checklist in free roam.
Most other trophies feed into it — do it last.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida: stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count. PowerPyx notes under-the-bridge flights are the quickest, and the 100% checklist needs 300, so keep going past 250.
steps: Do stunts of any kind — jumps, bridges, knife flights, base jumps.
Track progress under Progress > Activities > Stunts.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. PowerPyx lists them as fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race and performing a stunt. Most pop naturally while working on other trophies; check Progress > Activities to see which types you still need.
steps: Open Progress > Activities to see the 9 types.
Do each type at least once.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the two ranges (PowerPyx lists 12 range locations and 42 gold medals). The medals are not too hard, per PowerPyx — practise the weapon types you are weakest at and come back when your Focus level is higher.
steps: Visit the shooting ranges.
Gold every challenge — 42 in total.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations (42 races in total, per PowerPyx). You only need one win per location, so move on as soon as a location is won.
steps: Find a Top Fun drone race.
Win at least one race at each of the 14 locations.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — any 20 distinct race locations count. PowerPyx lists 40 unique race locations, so pick the ones you enjoy and skip the rest.
steps: Race at new locations.
Win 20 different ones.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Follow Cal's fishing questline: after the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, Cal texts you a fishing spot, and the strand ends in a fishing challenge against him. Beat him to pop the trophy (PowerPyx).
steps: Finish the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui.
Follow Cal's texts to the fishing spot.
Beat Cal in the fishing challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one of the four in-game arcade games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind or Bang For Your Buck (PowerPyx). The first three play on the TV at home from Chapter 1; Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines. You must reach the end of a game, not beat every challenge in it.
steps: Pick any of the four arcade games.
Play it through to the end.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's questline, which is Lucia-only and starts with a call from Andy in Chapter 3; her strand runs through five quests ending in Puff Puff Pass (PowerPyx). All of it stays available after the story.
steps: Play as Lucia in Chapter 3 and take Andy's call.
Finish her five quests, ending in Puff Puff Pass.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving questline: he marks shipwreck treasure chests on the map and you dive for them, seven shipwrecks in total (PowerPyx). Kenton goes quiet for a stretch of the story but returns later, so this is not missable.
steps: Take Kenton's call after Island Dreams in Chapter 1.
Dive all seven shipwrecks and bring the treasure back.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's five quests at the Thrillbilly Mud Club, starting after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break (PowerPyx). All of them stay available after the story.
steps: Finish Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
Complete Billy's five quests at the Mud Club.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 Strangers & Freaks mission strands. PowerPyx confirms the Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete strands count, while Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy and Billy do not count toward this trophy (they have their own). Save-watch: OutputLag warns Yago's Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 is time-sensitive (hourglass icon), so do it the moment it appears.
steps: Finish 8 stranger strands — Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count.
Do Yago's Race Against Yago as soon as it appears.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's Wish List: after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS gives you the Key Cloner, Randy wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage (PowerPyx). Scan cars with the WAiNK app to check them against the list, and deliver them in good condition for more money.
steps: Finish Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS in Chapter 3.
Deliver the 16 sports cars on Randy's list.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's strand, Jason-only: after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, destroy the Synthetic Labs, then take Tyrone's second quest, Spin On This (PowerPyx). All of it stays available after the story.
steps: As Jason, finish Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3.
Destroy the Synthetic Labs, then finish Spin On This.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: The only trophy reported as possibly missable: one meditation at Jason's house exists only in Chapter 1 (PowerPyx, OutputLag, KeenGamer). Do it before Chapter 1 ends and keep a Chapter 1 save.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida (10 locations; meditating with both characters at a spot counts twice, per PowerPyx). THE ONE TO WATCH: PowerPyx and OutputLag both report a first meditation at Jason's house in Chapter 1 — after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning and follow her to the balcony. It is gone after Chapter 1, and it is not yet confirmed whether it is strictly required, so do it and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.
steps: In Chapter 1, after Down to Earth, accept Lucia's balcony meditation.
Meditate at all 18 spots — bring your partner so each counts twice.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Finish Bret Vogel's hunting questline, Jason-only: it starts with a text from Bret after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, and he sends you after animals through 15 Target Decks (PowerPyx). A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine; which exact animal pops the trophy is still being confirmed.
steps: As Jason, take Bret's text after Coffee Break.
Work through his hunting quests and Target Decks.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets — find the cards around Leonida and finish any three sets (PowerPyx lists 18 card-set locations). Cards are a pure collectible grind, doable any time in free roam.
steps: Collect cards around Leonida.
Complete any 3 full sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app — hold Up, then R1 while looking at a landmark, curiosity or sculpture (PowerPyx counts 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures). There are far more than 100 scannable spots, so scan whatever you pass; this overlaps with discovering vehicles.
steps: Open the WAiNK app and scan landmarks, curiosities and sculptures.
Scan any 100 locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 Challenges (Progress > Challenges). The 100% checklist needs 70, so this pops on the way there (PowerPyx). Pick the easiest ones last and skip the hardest — ten spares are built in.
steps: Check Progress > Challenges.
Complete any 50 of the 80.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then escape the red heat zone completely — not just the flashing search area. PowerPyx notes bank vault robberies give 4 stars automatically, so this often pops during Maximum Withdrawal; a train tunnel north of Ambrosia is a handy escape route.
steps: Call your partner to join you.
Reach 4 stars, then escape the red heat zone entirely.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Call your partner, then rob three shops back-to-back while the wanted level never drops. Keep the flashing wanted level alive between shops and loot something in each (PowerPyx); the pop can be delayed about 30 seconds after the third shop. If it does not pop, hit a fourth shop and keep going.
steps: Call your partner.
Rob three shops in a row without losing the wanted level.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive — you do not need to drive them (PowerPyx). The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models, so this comes naturally.
steps: Scan passing vehicles with the WAiNK app.
Discover any 100 vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus (L3+R3 while aiming). Buff Focus with food or Adrenaline first, then line up a group — gang-operation guards work well — and use an assault rifle (PowerPyx). It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians, so pick gang enemies.
steps: Buff Focus with food or Adrenaline.
In one Combat Focus, down 5 gang enemies.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge at VCIA — planes parked out on the airfield do not count. PowerPyx and OutputLag both point to gates E3/E4: get in, reach the cockpit, reverse out and take off, then fly about 1 km from the airport before it pops. Save first; the police respond fast.
steps: Go to VCIA gates E3/E4.
Steal the docked plane, take off and fly about 1 km away.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank (a Rhino) at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the far south-west of the map; the tanks sit on the south side of the base (PowerPyx). Get in and drive and fire until it pops.
steps: Go to Mile Zero Air Station, south side.
Enter a Rhino tank and drive and fire.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which gives you the Snap Gun and unlocks jewelry robberies. Enter a store through its locked back door with the Snap Gun — kicking the door sets off the alarm — find the safe code note in the back room, loot the safe and leave unseen (PowerPyx). Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target (OutputLag).
steps: Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3.
Snap-Gun the back door, loot the safe, leave unseen.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults unlock through the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the guard has the vault open — bring your partner, you cannot carry all the bags alone — then escape the heat (PowerPyx). There are 8 vaults in total and the 100% checklist needs all 8.
steps: Finish That's Where The Money Is in Chapter 4.
Rob 5 vaults with your partner and escape each time.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It pops during the same Chapter 4 mission as Maximum Withdrawal — tailing the van to a bank counts — or earlier by blocking a truck, sticky-bombing its back door and escaping the heat (PowerPyx). The pop comes only after you leave the red heat zone.
steps: Tail an armored truck to a bank, or sticky-bomb one on the street.
Escape the red heat zone.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the map by visiting all 52 areas of Leonida. Flying a plane over the fogged areas is the fastest way (PowerPyx); the trophy pops once the whole map is revealed.
steps: Fly or drive through every fogged part of the map.
Explore all 52 areas.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs (39 operations exist; the 100% checklist needs all of them, per PowerPyx). Operations show as yellow icons when you get near them, and you can track each gang's count under Progress > Gangs.
steps: Find illegal operations (yellow icons).
Rob at least one for each of the 9 gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Not yet verified in-game — method follows from the official description. The description points to a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach; PowerPyx and OutputLag both list this trophy's method as currently unknown at launch, so treat any specific bar or spot as unconfirmed until a guide verifies it.
steps: Follow the official description: a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
Not yet verified — no confirmed spot yet.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window (PowerPyx). You need the Key Cloner from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS first; the pop is slightly delayed, after you drive away down the street. PowerPyx notes it is an easter egg nod to the Banshee from GTA III.
steps: Get the Key Cloner in Chapter 3.
Steal the blue Banshee and drive it through the showroom window.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Rob Kingpin Bowling, the Kolt & Associates bowling alley in Port Gellhorn: take all three key valuables — the luxury watch, the unique Gutterball shotgun and the office safe, blown open with Sticky Bombs — then escape the police (PowerPyx). It is not missable: if you miss an item, the operation respawns later.
steps: Buy Sticky Bombs at an Ammu-Nation.
Take the watch, the shotgun and the safe at Kingpin Bowling, then escape.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time (PowerPyx). Buy a gym membership, always train with your partner along — while one works out, the other trains too — and check each character's Strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia.
steps: Buy a gym membership.
Train with your partner until both reach max Strength.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile; the trophy list itself tracks the count (PowerPyx). Robberies, fights and clean escapes all feed it, and it should fill passively while you work on the rest of the list. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications) to watch it climb. Note the profile itself matters: PowerPyx warns the Irredeemable profile is permanent and makes police more aggressive, so keep a save before big choices.
steps: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications.
Play normally — robberies and fights count toward 500.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Not yet verified in-game — method follows from the official description. 'Second time's the charm' suggests succeeding on a second attempt at something; PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. Do not chase a specific method until it is confirmed.
steps: Follow the official description: succeed on a second try.
Not yet verified — no confirmed method yet.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Not yet verified in-game — method follows from the official description. 'What the hell just happened?' points to a strange scripted moment; PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be tied to a UFO questline. It will most likely pop while playing normally.
steps: Follow the official description: witness something strange.
Not yet verified — no confirmed trigger yet.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Not yet verified in-game — method follows from the official description. 'Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by' reads as knocking someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle; PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to involve kicking enemies while riding a motorcycle. Try it in free roam and watch for the pop.
steps: Try a melee attack from a moving motorcycle.
Not yet verified — no confirmed method yet.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts (cumulative). Marked bills come from bank and payday-loan jobs, and you sell them on to contacts (OutputLag). Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 each, so this builds fast once vaults are open (PowerPyx).
steps: Rob banks and payday loans to get Marked Bills.
Launder $250,000 through your contacts.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops, cumulatively — every kind of shop counts (OutputLag). It fills naturally as you buy weapons, clothes, food and garages; check your total in the trophy tracker if it has not popped by the endgame.
steps: Shop normally across all store types.
Spend $100,000 in total.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver; together they cost about $160,000, and story-given garages do not count (OutputLag). You need the garage space for the Scooter Bros registrations too, so buy garages first.
steps: Finish Daily Driver in Chapter 2.
Buy all 8 garages in the Real Estate app.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the app: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register; from Chapter 3 you can also use a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray (OutputLag). Each car needs a free garage space.
steps: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Moses.
Register 10 vehicles — Respray then Register.
